activity.notes: First reign of Azim ud-Din I (Alimuddin I) as Sultan of Sulu, 1735–1748. His later baptism under the Christian name Don Fernando de Alimuddin refers to the same individual and is not modeled as a separate ruler identity.

sources.title: Azim ud-Din I of Sulu
sources.citation_text: The compiled account records Azim ud-Din I (Alimuddin I) as Sultan of Sulu in 1735–1748 and again in 1764–1774, and identifies Don Fernando de Alimuddin as his Christian baptismal name rather than a separate ruler.
